property_summary: For any admissible input that does not revert, calling the transfer function through a high-level Solidity call should return exactly true; the mutant omits the return statement, causing a high-level Solidity call to read a default zeroed return value (false), which violates the rule that a successful non-reverting call must return true.
change_summary: Delete the return statement, causing the function to not return a value (relying on fallback assembly return or default).
